summary_en: This study tests tocilizumab given together with atezolizumab in adults with advanced non-small cell lung cancer that did not respond to first-line immune checkpoint inhibitor-based therapy. Atezolizumab 1200 mg and tocilizumab 6 mg/kg (or 4 mg/kg) are given by IV infusion every 21 days; how long treatment continues is not stated. The study is Phase 1/Phase 2 and aims to evaluate safety and effectiveness; the specific main outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa tocilizumab administrado junto con atezolizumab en adultos con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas avanzado que no respondió a la terapia de primera línea basada en inhibidores de puntos de control inmunitario. Atezolizumab 1200 mg y tocilizumab 6 mg/kg (o 4 mg/kg) se administran por infusión intravenosa cada 21 días; no se indica cuánto tiempo continúa el tratamiento. El estudio es de Fase 1/Fase 2 y busca evaluar la seguridad y la eficacia; la medida de resultado principal específica no se indica.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with advanced non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer (Stage IV or recurrent after curative-intent therapy).
Has had at least one prior line of therapy.
Received a checkpoint inhibitor in the line of therapy immediately before joining the trial.
not_for: Has a driver mutation that responds to targeted therapy.
Had prior immunotherapy side effects above grade 3.
Has another active invasive cancer needing ongoing treatment.
Has progressing or untreated brain metastases, or leptomeningeal disease.
Has a history of autoimmune disease or interstitial pulmonary fibrosis (IPF).
